visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view of a person's hands holding a rectangular, frosted glass makeup tube with a tan cap. The label 'JAVIN DE SEOUL' is visible. The background is blurred, showing a hint of an indoor home environment with soft lighting. (2) A medium shot of an Asian woman with short, dark wavy hair and bangs. She is wearing a black top and speaking directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor room with white cabinets in the background. (3) A close-up of the woman's face as she uses a thin makeup brush to apply a brown contouring cream to the side of her nose. Her eyes are focused on the mirror/camera. (4) The woman pulls back to a medium shot, holding the brush and makeup tube, looking surprised and then laughing. The lighting remains bright and natural. (5) Back to a close-up, she carefully applies more contour cream to the tip of her nose and her upper eyelid with the brush. Her facial expression is concentrated. (6) A medium shot showing her tilting her head up to apply the product heavily along her jawline and under her chin, creating a dark, unblended line. She makes a playful, exaggerated 'double chin' face. (7) She uses a larger, fluffy brush to blend the dark jawline contour upwards towards her ear. She tilts her head to show the transition from unblended to blended. (8) The final phase shows her smiling at the camera, gesturing with her hands to show her face. She holds up the product tube one last time before waving goodbye to the lens. Sparkle effects appear around her head briefly.
